name: Exp_ColorZerolagMomentum_X2
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagMomentum indicator, a zero-lag momentum oscillator that uses multiple smoothed momentum calculations to reduce lag. It enters long positions when momentum turns bullish and short positions when momentum turns bearish, with a two-tier signal confirmation system (X2).
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZerolagMomentum指标进行交易，这是一种零滞后动量振荡器，通过多重平滑动量计算来减少滞后。当动量转为看涨时做多，动量转为看跌时做空，采用双层信号确认系统(X2)。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于零滞后动量指标(ColorZerolagMomentum)，该指标通过对多个不同周期的动量值进行加权平均来消除传统动量指标的滞后性。入场条件为当零滞后动量指标的颜色从红色变为绿色（或反之）时产生交易信号，X2版本意味着需要两层信号确认才会开仓，提高了信号的可靠性。出场条件包括反向信号出现时平仓以及止损/止盈触发时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可以通过参数设置交易手数。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数供用户设置，但缺乏基于账户余额的动态仓位调整机制。整体策略属于典型的动量跟踪系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ColorZerolagMomentum indicator, which eliminates the lag of traditional momentum indicators by computing a weighted average of multiple momentum values across different periods. Entry conditions are triggered when the zero-lag momentum indicator changes color from red to green (bullish) or green to red (bearish), with the X2 variant requiring a two-tier signal confirmation before opening a position, thereby improving signal reliability. Exit conditions include closing positions when a reverse signal appears or when stop-loss/take-profit levels are hit. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user can set the trading volume via parameters. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters for the user, but lacks dynamic position sizing based on account equity or risk percentage. The overall strategy is a typical momentum-following system best suited for markets with clear trending conditions.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0表示不使用

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理开关，0=固定手数，1=按比例计算

pros: 零滞后动量指标减少了传统动量指标的信号延迟，入场更及时
X2双层信号确认机制降低了虚假信号导致的频繁交易
多周期动量加权平滑使指标对市场噪声有较好的过滤能力
提供移动止损功能，有助于锁定已有利润
参数化设计允许用户灵活调整各层动量周期
pros_en: Zero-lag momentum indicator reduces signal delay compared to traditional momentum indicators, enabling more timely entries
X2 two-tier signal confirmation mechanism reduces frequent trades caused by false signals
Multi-period weighted momentum smoothing provides good filtering against market noise
Trailing stop feature helps lock in existing profits
Parameterized design allows users to flexibly adjust each momentum period layer
cons: 固定手数模式缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动自动调整风险敞口
止损默认值为0，用户若不主动设置则交易无止损保护，风险极高
动量策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致连续亏损
缺乏交易时间过滤和 Spread 过滤，可能在不利的交易时段开仓
没有回撤控制机制，无法在资金曲线大幅回撤时自动降低仓位或暂停交易
cons_en: Fixed lot mode lacks dynamic position sizing, unable to automatically adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Default stop-loss value is 0, posing extreme risk if users do not actively set it, leaving trades unprotected
Momentum strategy tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lacks trading session filter and spread filter, may open positions during unfavorable trading hours
No drawdown control mechanism to automatically reduce position size or pause trading during significant equity drawdowns
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理模块，基于ATR或账户风险比例自动计算最优手数
添加交易时段过滤和Spread过滤，避免在低流动性或高点差时段开仓
增加回撤控制和最大连续亏损次数限制，在不利情况下自动降低风险暴露
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing module that automatically calculates optimal lot size based on ATR or account risk percentage
Add trading session filter and spread filter to avoid opening positions during low liquidity or high spread periods
Add drawdown control and maximum consecutive loss limits to automatically reduce risk exposure under adverse conditions

risk_points: 止损默认值为0，新用户可能在不设止损的情况下运行EA，面临无限亏损风险
动量策略在震荡市中容易频繁开仓平仓，导致手续费侵蚀和连续亏损
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss is 0, new users may run the EA without stop-loss, facing unlimited loss risk
Momentum strategy tends to frequently open and close positions in ranging markets, leading to commission erosion and consecutive losses
Lacks new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions within the same bar

It enters long positions when momentum turns bullish and short positions when momentum turns bearish, with a two-tier signal confirmation system (X2).
